traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for 022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE are implemented and verified: - Parser behavior is updated to detect non-traceability JSDoc tags as boundaries and only continue multi-line annotations when the next line is not a JSDoc tag, via normalizeCommentLine and isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine. - Comprehensive tests cover traceability annotations before, after, and interleaved with other JSDoc tags, as well as multi-line annotations and the previously failing REQ-OPTIMIZATION + @param scenario from Issue #3. - Documentation in docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md explicitly documents JSDoc coexistence and includes examples that match the story’s implementation notes. - The full Jest suite, including all relevant tests for this story and its dependencies, passes, demonstrating both correctness and backward compatibility.
Given this evidence, the story is fully implemented and passes all defined acceptance criteria.
